subject: Request: new slot for expanded security & procurement review
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sabrina Liao <sabrina.liao@acmecloud.com>, Tom Park <tom.park@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T16:12:00-08:00
Subject: Redwood demo — quick availability

Hi Sabrina / Tom,

Thanks again for the time earlier this week. We'd like to run a 45-minute demo that covers the platform, routing/fallbacks, and a short security + procurement Q&A. Can you confirm whether any of these windows work for your team next week?

- Tue 2026-12-01 09:00–09:45 PT
- Tue 2026-12-01 13:00–13:45 PT
- Wed 2026-12-02 11:00–11:45 PT

If none of those work, tell me a couple of slots that do and we’ll accommodate. I’ll include the right members on our side once you confirm which stakeholders will attend.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (stub)]
From: Sabrina Liao <sabrina.liao@acmecloud.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Tom Park <tom.park@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T18:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — quick availability

Hi Rafael,

Appreciate the follow-up. Heads up — we've added security, platform infra, and procurement leads to this review and they'll need to be on the call. Specifically:
- Security: Tom Park (will join if schedule permits)
- Platform/Infra: Sabrina (me) and the infra lead (I will loop in separately)
- Procurement: procurement@acmecloud.com will need to attend for T&Cs/discovery

One complication: Tom is traveling on 2026-12-01 and is only available after 2026-12-06. If the team can do the 2026-12-07 window that would be ideal. Also sharing our prep doc and initial security questionnaire for your team to review before the call.

[Attachment: acme-security-questions.pdf]

Can you propose alternatives starting the week of Dec 7?

Best,
Sabrina Liao
Director, Cloud Platform | AcmeCloud
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sabrina Liao <sabrina.liao@acmecloud.com>, Tom Park <tom.park@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — quick availability

Thanks for the heads up, Sabrina — and welcome to the broader group.

I've looped in Dev (infrastructure lead), Neha (security/compliance), and Laura (customer success) so we have the right folks on our side. We can absolutely move to the week of Dec 7. Proposed slots (all PT):

- Mon 2026-12-07 10:00–10:45
- Mon 2026-12-07 15:00–15:45
- Tue 2026-12-08 09:00–09:45

We will prepare a focused agenda: 20m platform walkthrough, 10m infra/security deep-dive, 15m procurement & next steps.

Quick ask for prep: can you send any procurement constraints or preferred contract terms we should flag ahead of time (NDA scope, data residency, billing cadence)? Neha will review the security questionnaire you attached and we’ll get back with any clarifying questions prior to the demo.

Rafael
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-11-27T08:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — quick availability

+1 on the Dec 7 options — I can take the infra/security slot. I'll prepare a one-slide infra checklist showing network ports, KV cache behavior for multi-tenant setups, and our recommended cert/KMS patterns.

Attaching a small org diagram so everyone knows who owns what on our side.

From: Sabrina Liao <sabrina.liao@acmecloud.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Park <tom.park@acmecloud.com>, AcmeCloud Procurement <procurement@acmecloud.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T10:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — quick availability

Thanks everyone — confirming Monday Dec 7 at 10:00 PT works for the core group. Tom will join remotely (he's on travel but confirmed availability for that slot). Procurement will be on the line for terms.

Please add the calendar invite to: tom.park@acmecloud.com and procurement@acmecloud.com. Here is a suggested calendar event link (feel free to use your Google invite): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123

Prep notes:
- Sabrina/Platform: we’d like to see connectors + routing behavior for hybrid cloud workloads.
- Tom/Security: we’ll cover the attached questionnaire; Neha, if you can flag any major gaps in advance that would be great.
- Procurement: we will review payment terms and standard SLAs in the last 10 minutes.

Looking forward to it — Sabrina
Director, Cloud Platform | AcmeCloud
